items.title: Edmond "Doc" Souchon Interview, 1962-02-17
items.q: Jack played in that outfit too, but I don't remember him like I do in front of my house

ctx.x: I remember when Rex had come in.

They came in on the river front. There was a substitute king, one float was a substitute king. And they came down, steamed down the river, and then they were met by the militia. Jack played in that outfit too, but I don't remember him like I do in front of my house, because many times they stopped directly in front of my house and people would dance in the streets. Not like today. Everybody was joining in on the thing.
How old would you be that you remember those things?

items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine, Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine and Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1959-02-27
items.q: I've got your picture here, too, with the doctor and all right here.

ctx.x: Merritt and Georgie, I'd go to the mother. Give it to the mother. It's full bits for you, full bits for you, full bits for you. Oh, man, they used to eat your head off of me. But Richie, I used to give Richie his full money and Henny. Give Henny his full money. More the days. Gosh, them were the days. More the days. I've seen that picture. That's Dennis Fire Company. Oh, that's the fire. It's a nice scrapbook. work. Mm-hmm. Yeah.
